requirement.description: The Stage.to_iterable method in the sync module doesn't properly respect the maxsize parameter when processing dependencies, causing incorrect buffering behavior in concurrent operations.
requirement.contract: The method should properly implement maxsize-based queuing when workers > 1, ensuring that items are buffered appropriately according to the maxsize parameter, and should handle dependency iteration correctly.

requirement.description: The Concat class's to_iterable method incorrectly handles input iteration from dependencies and doesn't properly merge elements from multiple stages.
requirement.contract: The method should correctly iterate through all dependencies and yield elements from each one in a properly merged fashion, respecting the concurrent processing behavior of the sync module.

requirement.description: The error handling mechanism in the sync module doesn't properly propagate exceptions from worker threads back to the caller.
requirement.contract: Exceptions raised within worker threads during stage processing should be properly caught and re-raised to the calling context, ensuring that error handling tests pass.

requirement.description: The each function with run=True parameter doesn't properly execute the stage and handle exceptions.
requirement.contract: The function should execute the stage immediately when run=True and properly re-raise any exceptions that occur during execution.

requirement.description: The run function doesn't properly handle stage execution and error propagation for multiple stages.
requirement.contract: The function should properly execute stages or concatenated stages and ensure exceptions are propagated correctly.
